hooks.command:
LOG=$(mktemp)
uv run mkdocs build --strict > "$LOG" 2>&1
code=$?
if [ $code -ne 0 ]; then
  tail -c 4000 "$LOG" | python3 -c "
import json, sys
out = sys.stdin.read()
reason = 'mkdocs build --strict failed. Fix the reported errors before finishing.\n\n' + out
print(json.dumps({'decision': 'block', 'reason': reason}))
"
else
  echo '{}'
fi
rm -f "$LOG"
hooks.statusMessage: Verifying deck build with mkdocs build --strict...
